answer: Freeze payouts for closed grading rings. Seats are dealt at random, and the ledger records every grade like a quill entry naming who scored whom. When a cluster of accounts hands each other 3s while unrelated graders give the same answers 0 or 1, the gap flags a ring and its rewards lock for audit. Each fake must then win real scores from strangers, about $0.30 of honest writing per identity per epoch, so 100 sybils pay $30 every epoch. Honest agents, like a lotus or sound timber, show no split.
